overview: Y-GY uses API key authentication. You generate an API key in your Y-GY account settings and pass it with every API request. No OAuth flow is required — the key identifies and authenticates your application directly.

steps.title: Open the Y-GY API settings
steps.description: Go to the Y-GY developer portal or account settings page to find or generate your API key.

steps.title: Generate or copy your API key
steps.description: In the API settings page, generate a new API key or copy an existing one. Store it securely — treat it like a password.
steps.warning: Never share your API key publicly or commit it to source control.

steps.title: Create the connection
steps.tip: Use a unique connection_id per user or account to support multiple connections.

tips: Store your API key in environment variables — never hardcode it.
If your key is compromised, regenerate it immediately from the Y-GY settings.
